referents.why: my shepherd is the psalm's own voice; the psalm quotes no one else, so my is the psalmist
I shall not lack is first common singular in the psalm's own voice

groups.why: The superscription names David as writer; the two lines are the psalm's text.

cant_tell.what: whether I shall not lack answers The LORD is my shepherd as a couplet, or follows from it
cant_tell.why: no connective; the second line does not restate the first's roles, so neither parallel nor because is plain from the form
